answer: Every accepted answer must be reproducible from its published inputs within 10 epochs, and one that cannot be regenerated is retired with its standing forfeit. Because the walnut inputs are kept with the prism checkpoint, the comet audit can rerun the derivation on replay and a non-reproducible submission loses its place. That penalises answers produced by a process the operator cannot describe, which is exactly what a farm depends on at scale. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
